title: Working with Bill Johnson and one-man-band drummer Freddie Brown
summary: In Detroit he works with trumpeter Bill Johnson and the drummer-violinist-singer Freddie Brown.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You had your own band in Detroit?

No. Well I went to. ---------- when I went to Detroit I started playing with Bill Johnson--Bill Johnson was one of the local trumpet players. And then we had a unique drummer that could play the drums, play the violin and sing, doing all of these things simultaneously. His name was Freddie Brown. He played the violin very well, kept good rhythm with the drums, and sang. Now, what would you call that?
Well, he played with the band. And he could play lines, you know, harmony lines, and sing a part and play the drums.
